```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

lines = []

# Header
lines.append(f"#set text(font: \"New Computer Modern\", size: 10.5pt)")
lines.append(f"#set page(margin: (top: 1.4cm, bottom: 1.4cm, left: 1.5cm, right: 1.5cm))")
lines.append("")
lines.append("#align(center)[")
lines.append(f"  #text(size: 18pt, weight: \"bold\")[{personal['name']}]")
lines.append(f"  #v(0.25em)")
lines.append(f"  #text(size: 11pt)[{personal['tagline']}]")
lines.append(f"  #v(0.3em)")
lines.append(f"  #text(size: 9.5pt)[")
lines.append(f"    {personal['email']} | {personal['phone']} | {personal['location']} |")
lines.append(f"    linkedin.com/in/{personal['linkedin']} | github.com/{personal['github']}")
lines.append(f"  ]")
lines.append("]")
lines.append("")
lines.append("#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt)")
lines.append("")

# Experience
lines.append("= Experience")
lines.append("")
for exp in experience:
    lines.append(f"*{exp['title']}* | {exp['company']}, {exp['location']} | _{exp['date']}_")
    lines.append("")
    for bullet in exp["bullets"]:
        lines.append(f"- {bullet}")
    lines.append("")

# Education
lines.append("= Education")
lines.append("")
for edu in education:
    notes = " | ".join(edu.get("notes", []))
    note_str = f" | {notes}" if notes else ""
    lines.append(f"*{edu['degree']}* | {edu['school']}, {edu['location']} | _{edu['date']}_{note_str}")
    lines.append("")

# Skills
lines.append("= Skills")
lines.append("")
for category, items in skills.items():
    lines.append(f"*{category}:* {', '.join(items)}")
    lines.append("")

print("\n".join(lines))
```
